title: QuadrantTaskBoard
description: A task board on a four-quadrant matrix, such as an Eisenhower matrix: the + of a quadrant header (or a click on its empty area) adds a task, compact edit and delete buttons on the active task (in its card, beside its name, on React) edit or delete it, a panel opened right at the + button or at the task names it and picks its quadrant, an inline confirmation guards every delete, and tasks move by drag and drop or Shift + arrow keys (a double click edits them). The board is controlled: pass the tasks as points and set back the list received by onPointsChange. It accepts the other props of QuadrantChart (axes, quadrant titles, badges and colors, ticks, labels…) and its buttons and panels follow the language of the app. Exported by minerva-design, not minerva-design/charts.

examples.title: Eisenhower board

QuadrantConfig.showTicks: Shows the numeric ticks of the axes; false keeps only the matrix

native.limitations: On React Native, tasks move by drag and drop or with the “Move to” actions of screen readers: there are no Shift + arrow key moves and no double tap to edit (use the edit button of the active task). The icons of the buttons are drawn with Views, without an SVG dependency.

basic.title: Eisenhower board
basic.description: Tap + or the empty area of a quadrant to add a task, tap a task to show its edit and delete buttons, and drag it to another quadrant. The sample names follow the app language until you rename them.

basic.title: Eisenhower board
basic.description: points, quadrants and axisLabels are set as properties, reverse-x, hide-ticks and height as attributes; the minerva-points-change listener sets the next list back as points.

props.points: Tasks { x, y, label, color, size }; set the detail of minerva-points-change back to update the board (controlled); property only
props.quadrants: Titles, badges and colors of the quadrants (topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft, bottomRight); property only
props.axisLabels: Texts at the ends of the dividers, drawn inside the plot (top, bottom, left, right); property only
props.xDomain: Range of the horizontal axis (default [0, 10]); property only
props.yDomain: Range of the vertical axis (default [0, 10]); property only
props.hideTicks: Hides the numeric ticks of the axes (only the matrix remains)
props.hideLabels: Hides the task names next to the dots
props.hideCounts: Hides the number of tasks in the quadrant headers
props.height: Height of the chart: pixels or any CSS length (default 320)
props.locale: Language of the built-in texts, default quadrant titles and numbers (e.g. "fr"); the library language by default
props.noAccessiblePoints: Leaves out the visually hidden list of the tasks (keyboard and screen reader access, Shift + arrow moves)
props.options: Other engine options of the chart (legend, tooltip, padding, palette…); property only

events.minerva-points-change: The tasks changed (add, edit, delete, drag and drop, keyboard move); detail: { points }, the next list to set back as points
events.minerva-point-click: A task was clicked (it becomes the selected one); detail: { point, index }
events.minerva-point-drag: A task is being dragged (on every move); detail: { point, index, x, y, quadrant }
events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) task changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned the chart; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The chart backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }
